xtop-cli developer context
==========================

Derived documentation for the xtop-cli organization. Upstream repositories
are authoritative. Flat checkout assumed at ~/repos/xtop-cli/.

Root documents
--------------
README.md            Overview, scope, repository map, reading order.
AGENTS.md            Operating rules for AI coding agents.
conventions.md       Versions, dependencies, naming, contracts, CI, git rules.
ecosystem.md         Architecture, dependency graph, integration modes.
repositories.md      Repository inventory and workspace members.
workflows.md         Cross-repo development, verification and release flows.
current-state.md     Dated status snapshot and known gaps.

Repository documents
--------------------
api/README.md                 Contract workspace: four crates.
api/architecture.md           Crate graph, ownership, consumption, path deps.
api/data-model.md             System model structs and snapshot lifecycle.
api/plugin-contract.md        Plugin trait, context, capabilities, host.
api/widget-contract.md        WidgetState, registrations, glyph helpers.
api/extension-contract.md     Server-style extension protocol.
api/effect-contract.md        Frame effect protocol.
api/changes.md                Decision log and breaking changes.
api/operations.md             Local CI, gates, publish checklist.

xtop/README.md                Kernel overview.
xtop/architecture.md          Module map, data flow, render pipeline.
xtop/cli.md                   Commands, flags, environment variables.
xtop/configuration.md         Config schema, persistence, asset seeding.
xtop/theming.md               Theme format v2, roles, contrast, themes.
xtop/layouts-and-widgets.md   Modes, presets, packs, runtime widgets.
xtop/plugins-and-extensions.md Plugin/extension hosting and MCP.
xtop/providers.md             Sysinfo provider and platform probes.
xtop/operations.md            Build, test, audit, packaging, release checklist.

widgets/README.md             Widget packs overview.
widgets/architecture.md       Crate model, shared engine, registry, packs.
widgets/widget-reference.md   Every widget and its layout options.
widgets/authoring.md          Creating and testing a widget crate.
widgets/operations.md         Local CI and install flow.

layouts/README.md             Layout crate overview.
layouts/schema.md             Full JSONC schema and tiling rules.
layouts/authoring.md          Writing, validating and installing layouts.
layouts/defaults.md           The ten embedded layouts.
layouts/operations.md         Local CI and review checklist.

plugins/README.md             Plugin workspace overview.
plugins/architecture.md       Samurai plugin and workspace layout.
plugins/samurai.md            Samurai action API reference.
plugins/rules.md              Ten heuristic detection rules.
plugins/runtime-widgets.md    Shared runtime widget model.
plugins/wasm-widgets.md       WASM host, ABI, draw list, sandbox.
plugins/external-widgets.md   External helper-process host.
plugins/operations.md         Local CI, examples, security notes.

extensions/README.md          Extension workspace overview.
extensions/architecture.md    MCP extension architecture.
extensions/mcp-protocol.md    JSON-RPC 2.0 wire protocol and tool table.
extensions/operations.md      Build, test, adding an extension.

effects/README.md             Effect workspace overview.
effects/architecture.md       Contract and workspace layout.
effects/catalog.md            Fade effect semantics.
effects/authoring.md          Writing, testing and landing an effect.
effects/operations.md         Local CI and release notes.

web/README.md                 Site overview.
web/architecture.md           Next.js export, docs pipeline, search, i18n.
web/content.md                Docs mirror, translations, landing copy.
web/operations.md             Build, docs sync, Pages deployment.

resources/README.md           How to use agents and skills.
resources/repos.md            Repository-to-path quick map.
resources/agents/*.md         Role definitions for coding agents.
resources/skills/*.md         Repeatable procedures.

Hard rules
----------
- Upstream source wins over this context.
- Contracts live only in api.
- All crates stay at 0.1.0; MSRV 1.87; Rust edition 2021.
- ratatui 0.30.2; serde 1; serde_json 1; no tokio/clap/chrono.
- Rust repos use local CI only; no new GitHub Actions.
- Never store secrets, tokens, keys or personal data here.
- No emojis.
